name: Moon
defines: Your inner life — what you need to feel safe, how you react before you have thought about it, and the conditions under which you can rest.

aries.definition: You settle by doing something about it. Feelings arrive fast, at full volume, and pass almost as quickly once they have been discharged.
aries.showsUp: You flare and then it is genuinely over, you cannot sit with a problem you are not allowed to act on, and you find slow emotional processing excruciating.

taurus.definition: You settle through the senses and through sameness. Comfort is physical for you — warmth, food, familiar surroundings, an unhurried afternoon.
taurus.showsUp: You calm down by eating something good or getting outside, you resist being rushed through a feeling, and sudden change unsettles you more than difficulty does.

gemini.definition: You settle by putting it into words. An unspoken feeling stays unresolved; naming it is most of the work of managing it.
gemini.showsUp: You talk or write your way out of a mood, you get restless when there is nothing new to think about, and you can rationalise a feeling before you have finished having it.

cancer.definition: You settle through closeness and continuity. Home, family and the people who have known you a long time are not comforts on top of life but the foundation of it.
cancer.showsUp: You feel other people's states as if they were your own, you keep things that carry memory, and you withdraw into your shell rather than say you have been hurt.

leo.definition: You settle when you feel valued. Being appreciated is not vanity for you — it is the evidence that you matter to the people you have given yourself to.
leo.showsUp: You are openly affectionate, you take being overlooked hard, and you recover quickly once someone genuinely sees you.

virgo.definition: You settle by putting things in order. Anxiety turns into a task list, and a tidied space or a solved problem does more for you than reassurance does.
virgo.showsUp: You clean, sort or fix when you are worried, you struggle to switch off from noticing what is wrong, and you look after people practically rather than sentimentally.

libra.definition: You settle when things are peaceful between people. Discord in the room registers in your body, and you cannot rest properly while something is unresolved.
libra.showsUp: You smooth things over quickly, you find raised voices genuinely destabilising, and you can agree to something you do not want in order to end the tension.

scorpio.definition: You settle only where you feel completely safe, and that takes a long time to establish. Your feelings run deep, private and all the way down.
scorpio.showsUp: You watch people carefully before you trust them, you feel things far more intensely than you show, and betrayal is the one thing you find almost impossible to undo.

sagittarius.definition: You settle when you can see a way out and a way forward. Optimism is an emotional strategy for you, not just a temperament.
sagittarius.showsUp: You get claustrophobic in heavy moods and other people's, you cheer yourself up by planning something, and you would rather laugh about a hurt than sit inside it.

capricorn.definition: You settle through competence. Feeling in control of your circumstances does more for your peace of mind than being comforted does.
capricorn.showsUp: You cope first and feel later, you find needing help harder than giving it, and you were often the steady one long before you should have had to be.

aquarius.definition: You settle by stepping back. Distance is how you regulate — you understand a feeling much better from a little way outside it.
aquarius.showsUp: You go cool rather than loud when upset, you need a lot of unsupervised time, and you can describe your emotions accurately while seeming detached from them.

pisces.definition: You settle when the boundaries soften. Music, water, sleep and imagination are not escapes for you so much as the medium you emotionally live in.
pisces.showsUp: You absorb the feeling of a room without meaning to, you need real solitude to recover from crowds, and you find it hard to tell your own mood from someone else's.
